title.value: The Stack: 3 TB of permissively licensed source code
title.justification: The title directly reflects the main subject of the paper, which is about a dataset called 'The Stack' consisting of 3 TB of permissively licensed source code.
title.quote: To stimulate open and responsible research on LLMs for code, we introduce The Stack, a 3.1 TB dataset consisting of permissively licensed source code in 30 programming languages.

extractions.description: This paper introduces 'The Stack', a dataset of 3.1 TB of permissively licensed source code aimed at promoting open and responsible research on Large Language Models (LLMs) for code. The dataset covers 30 programming languages and emphasizes transparency and data governance. The paper discusses the collection process, license detection, data deduplication, and presents experimental results on text2code benchmarks. It also addresses data governance issues, including an opt-out process for developers who do not want their code included in the dataset.

primary_category.justification: While the paper contributes significantly to the field of AI and machine learning, particularly in dataset collection and management for code-based LLMs, it does not address any specific eco-responsible AI application or category outlined in the list provided.
primary_category.quote: The Stack is an output of the BigCode Project. BigCode aims to be responsible by design and by default. The project is conducted in the spirit of Open Science, focused on the responsible development of LLMs for code.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not discuss or imply any secondary connection to eco-responsible AI categories as defined.
secondary_categories.quote: Our experimental results show that near-deduplication is an important pre-processing step for achieving competitive results on text2code benchmarks.

applications.quote: One of the goals of this project is to give developers agency over their source code and let them decide whether or not it can be used to develop and evaluate LLMs.
